segments.text: Worried that switching tools means weeks of setup? Here's your actual first week with Lanyard. Day one: you invite your providers, and they complete their own profiles in a guided portal.
When an application comes in, you review and approve with one click. That creates their account — no IT project, no imports.
Then Lanyard goes to work: it pulls each provider's full profile from CAQH automatically — licenses, history, documents — usually before you've finished your coffee.
By Friday, your roster is in, organized, and tracked. Lanyard Health — credentialing on autopilot.
